name: Prone I-Raise
steps: Lie face down with your arms straight alongside your torso, palms facing in toward your thighs.
Roll your shoulders back and down away from your ears, reaching your fingertips actively toward your heels.
Lift your straight arms a few inches off the floor, engaging your lats and lower scapular stabilizers.
Hold for two seconds at the top of the lift while keeping your forehead lightly touching the mat.
Gently lower your arms back down to rest.
coaching_cues: Think of sliding your shoulder blades into your back pockets.
Keep the back of your neck long and avoid looking forward.
Engage your glutes slightly to stabilize your pelvis.
